## Description

The largest white blood cell (~12–20 µm): a kidney-shaped nucleus and grey-blue cytoplasm with
vacuoles. In tissues it becomes a macrophage.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: not seeded in the default drops (inoculate it from the Catalogue).

Prepared plates: `blood_smear`.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A still cell of the `blood_smear` [slide](../../mechanics/prepared-plates-and-tissues.md#fixed-preparations).
